name: stream_encoder
summary: Warm CLIP daemon that tails every JSONL sink in the substrate (program_events, correlations, mocap, DOM, render output) and embeds EVERY event in real-time to a single continuous JSONL stream. The NN's vector axis (the 'V' in dim_pack's vector/circle/hex/rgb/fps) now carries real semantic signal instead of SHA-256 noise. Text events and image events share the same 512-d embedding space so a Pump.fun-buy and a render of its golden vortex sit at related coordinates.
engine_pattern: Tail-and-encode loop. JSONL offset state at ~/.cc/embeddings/_encoder_offsets.json so reload picks up where left off. Single-instance lockfile at ~/.cc/embeddings/_encoder.lock with stale-PID detection. Auto-fallback to CPU if CUDA OOM. SIGINT graceful shutdown.

row_fields: vec_hex (L2-normalized float32 packed to hex — 2048 chars for 512-d)

canonical_sentence_flattening: Each source has a custom event_to_sentence() that builds a short English description CLIP's text encoder sees. Pump.fun buys become 'buy on Pump.fun bonding curve memecoin_launchpad chain solana'. Correlations become 'intent signAndSendTransaction correlated to 71 chain events on MEMECOIN_LAUNCHPAD with actions other,sell,buy'. Mocap becomes 'motion capture frame with 8 joints including Head,Hips,LeftHandWrist'. Same event → same sentence → same embedding.
image_path_short_circuit: When an event references image_path/out_path that exists on disk, CLIP image encoder fires instead of text. Lets render tiles and Snap webcam frames join the same vector space as chain text events.
wires_dim_pack: dimension_pack._vector_hex_64 now checks: (1) record.embedding_hex inline, (2) embedding_index by crystal_id, (3) multi_layer_hex pack, (4) SHA-256 fallback. So the vector axis carries real CLIP signal whenever the encoder has seen the event.
cli: one --source X --kind X   (reads single event JSON from stdin, prints encoded row)
venv_note: MUST run under /data/Projects/ComfyUI/.venv/bin/python (has torch + transformers). The cc dispatcher autoselects it; system python3 falls back gracefully but can't load CLIP.

five_canonical_frames_per_encoded_event.vector: REAL CLIP-512 embedding (replaces SHA-256 fallback in dim_pack)
five_canonical_frames_per_encoded_event.hex: crystal_anchor — same crystal joins the chain-of-events
five_canonical_frames_per_encoded_event.fps: ts → frame_pack across 24/30/60/90/120 — same as every other event

outbound_calls: core/lib/dimension_pack.emit (indirect — encoded events become dim_pack input)
substrate_reads: every JSONL sink declared in SINKS (read-only, offset-tracked)
